    Our Legacy

    A Studio That
    Thiruthangal Calls
    Its Own

    "Photo Sami Kadai" — that is what the people of Thiruthangal have lovingly called us for four decades.

    Since 1983, Sankar Digital Studio has stood as Thiruthangal's most trusted photography studio. From film rolls to 4K drone cinematics, we have grown with every era of photography — never failing to meet customer satisfaction.


    Also known as "Sankar Sami Kadai" and "Murugan Kovil Photo Kadai" — a true Thiruthangal landmark.

    Our Journey

    43 Years of
    Capturing Life

    From a young apprentice with a film camera to the most trusted digital studio in Thiruthangal.

    "Four decades ago I picked up a camera for the first time. Today, every photo we take carries the same passion — to capture a moment that lasts forever."

    — Sankar, Founder
    1983
    A Passion for Photography Begins

    A young, passionate photographer steps into the world of photography in Thiruthangal, Tamil Nadu — armed with nothing but a camera and an unshakeable love for capturing life's moments.

    🎓 The First Frame
    1983 – 1990
    Apprenticeship at New Rathna Studio

    For nearly a decade, Sankar worked under his uncle at New Rathna Studio, Thiruthangal. He mastered film photography, studio lighting, portrait techniques, and the art of connecting with people. These foundational years shaped everything that was to come.

    🌏 Apprenticeship & Growth
    ~1988
    Sankar Digital Studio is Born

    Sankar stepped out on his own and founded Sankar Digital Studio on Virudhunagar Main Road, Thiruthangal — quickly becoming a community landmark lovingly known as "Photo Sami Kadai" and "Sankar Sami Kadai".

    🏠 A New Beginning
    2005
    First Computer — Going Digital

    A major milestone: Sankar Digital Studio acquired its first computer and began processing photographs digitally — ahead of its time for Thiruthangal. The studio also expanded into lamination, XEROX, colour printing, and government document services.

    💻 The Digital Revolution
    2018 – Present
    Drone, 4K & Modern Cinematics

    Today, Sankar Digital Studio has embraced the very latest — DJI drones for aerial cinematography, 4K 120FPS video, gimbal-stabilised shots, cinematic pre-wedding films, and LED TV displays. 43 years on, the passion burns brighter than ever.

    🚀 Present Day

    Our Craft

    What We
    Create for You

    Professional photography, cinematic videography, and digital services — all under one roof in Thiruthangal since 1983.

    01
    Signature Service💍
    Wedding & Marriage Photography

    Full-day wedding coverage from the first moment to the last celebration. Every emotion, every ritual, every candid moment — in both traditional and cinematic styles. 43 years of wedding photography expertise.

    ⭐ Most Popular
    02
    Cinematic💑
    Pre-Wedding Shoot

    Creative outdoor and indoor sessions capturing your love story. Multiple locations, mood-driven setups, and cinematic editing for unforgettable memories before the big day.

    03

    DJI Drone Photography

    Breathtaking aerial perspectives using DJI drones. Perfect for weddings, events, land showcases, and property photography from the sky.

    Passport & Visa Photos

    Instant passport-size photos meeting all government specifications. Same-day delivery, correct background and dimensions for every country and embassy.

    Large group photography for family reunions, corporate events, college gatherings, and community occasions of any size.

    Professional building, interiors, and real estate photography for commercial and residential properties.

    Online Document
    & Bill Services

    Bill Payments

    • TNEB Electricity (up to ₹1,000)₹15
    • TNEB Electricity (₹1,001–5,000)₹30
    • TNEB Electricity (above ₹5,000)₹50
    • Property Tax Payment₹15
    • Water & Sewerage Tax₹15
    • Professional Tax Payment₹25
    • Municipal Drainage Charges₹40
    Pay your bills and get a printed receipt instantly. Bring cash and your consumer or assessment number.
    📂

    Land & Property Records

    • Patta / Chitta Extract₹30
    • A-Register Extract₹30

    Bring your survey number and district/taluk details. We access TN land records portal and print cleanly.
